question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

My brother __is resembling__ my mother.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'resembles'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment of the sentence is:** 'resembles'.**
 
• The given sentence is in **'Present Indefinite Tense'.** So, the verb will be according to it.
 
• So, replacing **'is resembling'** with **'resembles'** will make the sentence correct as the subject is singular here so plural verb must be used.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 2'. **

**Correct sentence**__**:** *My brother **__resembles__** my mother.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'was resembling'** is in **'Past Continuous Tense'.** So It is not inappropriate here. 
 
• **'had resembled'** is in** 'Past Perfect Tense'.** So It is not inappropriate here. 
 
• **'had been resembling' **is in **'Past Perfect Continuous Tense'.** So It is not inappropriate here.
